scientific_findings.statistical_scope: post-v1/content001 source-registered study; same previously observed test datasets; three-seed core descriptive

stage4.mechanism_interpretation: Eight paired seeds, two fixed tasks averaged within each seed, four exact sign-flip comparisons in one Holm family. All positive gates false. Lack of a significant contrast is not equivalence.
model_limits: Eight active spatial cells and two Erlang refractory phases approximate the process.
Marginal retained distributions do not retain all cross-channel/high-dimensional correlations.
Active-mean-collapse preserves refractory phases; this is not a no-reset or complete reset-law ablation.
Analytic Brownian/Erlang boundary and grid-policy J/G are not proved task-optimal classification values.

lif_supplement.statistics_scope: Three paired training seeds per fixed task, descriptive raw differences/mean/SD/range. No new superiority gate, p-value or Holm family.

generalization_limits: Previously observed v1/content001/content002 datasets; no fresh-test confirmation.
Three-seed core and LIF comparisons are descriptive, not a new superiority gate.
CONTENT002 multimodal_select is queried digit image/audio selection, not natural paired audiovisual retrieval.
FSDD uses 600 speaker-disjoint recordings, offline features and repeated episodes; no broad speech or foundation-model claim.
Real content tasks have no registered OOD split; synthetic irregular OOD changes sequence length and time scale together.
Sampling subdivision preserves an external label-integral oracle; the learned encoder is not guaranteed to have an exact semigroup under subdivision.

v1_scaling.rss_scope: cumulative whole-process high-water mark, not isolated model memory

v1_native003.interpretation: Actual price-conditioned neural score controls real owner KEEP/STOP, but a stronger explicitly posthoc ordinary fixed-prefix schedule exceeds the value head. One fixed backbone/one head seed does not establish HCSN architecture superiority.

prohibited_inferences: CPU seconds are not measured energy.
Constant inference state in one recurrent model is not a measured memory advantage over unmeasured baseline caches.
Synthetic forward/Adam timing without matched learned quality is not equal-quality cost superiority.
Source/preflight/registration/static review is not a completed training study.
Native receipt causality is not task-optimal stopping or general architecture quality.

current_acceleration_package.classification: Separate current-run model fidelity, normalization, recovery, real-owner message causality and synthetic timing evidence; these do not change the earlier scientific gates.
current_acceleration_package.formal_training_status_at_this_audit: New formal-study outcomes are deliberately excluded from this prior audit; no completion or trained-checkpoint acceptance is asserted here.
current_acceleration_package.future_trained_execution_binding: EXECUTION_BINDING_PLAN.json fixes family=fixed,task=selective_copy,model=hcsn_accelerated,seed=98031; use its validation-selected selected.npz only after the formal run completes.

audit_conclusion: The parent commit supports implemented differentiable finite-distribution neurons and several executed small empirical/engineering studies. It does not support general superiority over ordinary gates, Transformer, LIF, natural-AV encoders or foundation-scale models. Do not promote unpublished scratch outcome claims into this prior-evidence ledger.
